links.outcome: Ward in-hospital cardiac arrest and in-hospital mortality after AI-SaMD implementation versus standard care
links.effect: IHCA aRR 0.79 (95% CI 0.65-0.96); mortality aRR 0.85 (95% CI 0.79-0.90); shorter hospital and ICU LOS. Neurological outcome, lead-time and full-code death analyses were not significant.
links.quote: In secondary hospitals unable to operate an RRS due to fiscal limitations, implementation of an AI-SaMD as an additional informational layer was associated with lower ward IHCA and in-hospital mortality.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world deployment and clinical impact of an AI clinical decision support system (DeepCARS) predicting in-hospital cardiac arrest versus standard care across three secondary hospitals, without testing specific deployment practices/guardrails.
